newsitem.title: ITALY: Tunisian dies, 21 rescued in shipwreck off Italy.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian dies, 21 rescued in shipwreck off Italy.

text.p: At least one Tunisian would-be immigrant was killed and 21 others were rescued on Saturday after their makeshift boat sank off this Italian island, coastguard officials said.
The eight-metre (26-foot) wooden boat broke into pieces after stormy seas sent it crashing into the rocky coast of Pantelleria, a tiny island between North Africa and Sicily.
Officials said that, according to survivors, a further five to 10 passengers might still be missing. A helicopter was combing the area in a search for any missing members of the group.
The survivors, who like many North African immigrants were seeking to enter Italy illegally via Pantelleria, were plucked from the sea by patrol boats.
